Ai yori Aoshi.name: Ai Yori Aoshi
Ai yori Aoshi.summary: A visual novel based on the anime of the same name. The name Ai Yori Aoshi comes from the quote "Blue comes from indigo, yet is bluer than indigo", meaning that people surpass their teachers through their own efforts.

AMF Xtreme Bowling 2006.name: AMF Xtreme Bowling 2006
AMF Xtreme Bowling 2006.summary: Experience the excitement of a night at the lanes with AMF Xtreme Bowling 2006. With six different gameplay modes, nine different enviornments and customizable character creation, the competition is always fresh and fun. Great to play alone or with a group of friends.

Edel Blume.name: Edel Blume
Edel Blume.summary: Edel Blume is a otome visual novel, developed by Design Factory and published by Idea Factory, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Empire of Atlantis.name: Empire of Atlantis
Empire of Atlantis.summary: Rodrigo, the fisherman's son one day finds a letter in a bottle on the beach. With some help of his grandfather he understands that it tells him how to find the famous lost city of Atlantis. Now Rodrigo and his grandfather along with their dog Uzo sets out on a journey to find the long lost island.

Generation of Chaos Desire.name: Generation of Chaos: Desire
Generation of Chaos Desire.summary: Generation of Chaos: Desire is a 2007 release in the Generation of Chaos series for PlayStation 2.

Mr. Bean.name: Mr Bean
Mr. Bean.summary: Mr Bean based from the animated TV series of the same name, you play as Mr Bean himself.

Zill O'll Infinite.name: Zill O'll Infinite
Zill O'll Infinite.summary:
Zill O’ll Infinite is a remastered and expanded version of the original PS1 JRPG Zill O’ll, released for the PlayStation 2. It features updated graphics and audio, new characters, dungeons, scenarios, and multiple endings. Set in the open world of Vyashion, players create a customizable character and complete missions through an adventurer’s guild. The game offers turn-based combat and a flexible story path shaped by player choices and relationships with various NPCs, leading to over 50 possible endings.

An enhanced PSP version, Zill O’ll Infinite Plus, added even more content and story elements.
